clip (archived under \texttt{outputs/*.positions-crash-attempt1}). No stage removes a repetition loop: the GPU baseline has almost none to remove ($8$-gram repetition $0.0122$ TR / $0.0000$ EN), and the correction stage raises it to $0.0908$ on Turkish. Biasing is not free: on the two clips that receive a glossary it multiplies wall clock ($1.8\times$ on TR-1 (129\,s to 230\,s); $7.2\times$ on EN-1 (55\,s to 398\,s)). The five clips with no gold list are unaffected by the prompt and reproduce the previous stage's hypotheses character for character, which doubles as a determinism control.}
